_comment: Engine self-test recipe (example / user content, ADR-006). Points at the local examples/selftest.html page so you can prove the full loop — launch, target by text, raw trusted CDP click — end to end, minimized, with no login or network. Run it with an absolute file URL, e.g.:  truklick run recipes/demo/selftest.json --url file:///ABSOLUTE/PATH/truklick/examples/selftest.html --once
name: Truklick self-test
